How It Works: The 4-Step Matching Process

American Shingle Co. takes the friction and uncertainty out of hiring a residential roofing contractor. Here is exactly what happens from your initial request to project completion.

Step 1: Submit Your Project Details or Call Direct

Begin by calling our toll-free phone line at (833) 348-0328 or completing our online estimate request form. We collect your property ZIP code, project type (full roof replacement, new installation, or storm damage inspection), and preferred shingle material.

Step 2: Rapid Match with a Licensed Local Contractor

Our algorithmic routing engine identifies the best-qualified independent roofing contractor in your immediate municipality. During standard operating hours, partner contractors are notified immediately and connect with you within 30 to 90 minutes to discuss your roof and schedule an on-site or high-resolution satellite inspection.

Step 3: On-Site Inspection & Itemized Written Estimate

Your matched roofing specialist conducts a physical roof assessment to evaluate:

  • Exact surface square footage and roof slope pitch
  • Condition of wood decking, fascia boards, and soffit ventilation
  • Existing shingle layers and tear-off disposal requirements
  • Flashing condition around chimneys, skylights, and valleys

You receive a transparent, itemized written proposal detailing materials, labor, permit fees, dumpster disposal, and warranty terms. There are never any obligations or high-pressure commitments.

Step 4: Professional Installation, Inspection & Cleanup

Once you approve the written proposal with the contractor, their certified crew coordinates material delivery and schedules the installation. Work is performed in compliance with local municipal building codes, followed by daily magnetic sweeps to remove all loose nails from your lawn, driveway, and walkways.

Who Do You Pay and How Much Does It Cost?

Zero Fee to Homeowners: Using American Shingle Co. is 100% free for homeowners. You do not pay us any membership or referral fees.

Direct Contractor Contract: All payments, deposits, contracts, and workmanship warranties are executed directly between you and the fulfilling licensed contractor. Payment schedules typically involve an initial deposit with final payment due upon completed municipal inspection and your personal satisfaction.

Referral Network & Legal Disclaimer: American Shingle Co. is a nationwide consumer referral and matching service. We are not a direct roofing contractor and do not perform roofing construction services ourselves. All roofing estimates, inspections, contracts, warranties, and permits are provided directly by independent, third-party licensed and insured roofing contractors in our referral network.

Contractor credentials, licensing numbers, and insurance coverage vary by state and local jurisdiction and are verified in accordance with state and municipal regulatory requirements. Always verify your fulfilling contractor's local license and permit documentation prior to contracting work.
